basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I recently adopted a kitten named Luna, who has quickly become my main source of joy and curiosity. When I'm not working on freelance design projects, I enjoy exploring the outdoors, tending to my growing collection of houseplants, particularly alocasia, and diving into fantasy novels. I love staying up late, which coincidentally aligns with Luna's active hours. Single and loving the independence, I tend to spend my online hours in the evenings after work. I occasionally dabble in online gaming, particularly in MMOs like Reign of Darkness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of formal education in graphic design and self-taught expertise in plant care. I frequently browse design forums and take online courses to expand my skill set. I also rely heavily on online communities for advice on pet care and plant maintenance.
